_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor Test and Evaluation Maintenance Data
summary: Specifies the format and content requirements for prime contractor maintenance data documenting maintenance performed on the system under test during contractor, developmental, and integrated operational test and evaluation periods.
use_relationship:
The Contractor Test and Evaluation Maintenance Data shall document maintenance performed by the prime on the system under test (SUT) during the following periods:
- Contractor Test and Evaluation
- Developmental Test and Evaluation
- Integrated Operational Test and Evaluation

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract.

The statement of work will identify the specific tests and activities that require maintenance reporting.  This information is used to categorize maintenance actions to calculate R&M metrics.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor Test and Evaluation Maintenance Data file shall adhere to the following characteristics so that it can be imported into U.S. Government databases:

children.title: Pipe delimited text file format
children.content: Formatted as a pipe delimited text file.

children.title: Trimmed field values
children.content: Trimmed field values (no spaces at beginning or end of field values).

children.title: Inclusion of every field listed in this DID
children.content: Inclusion of every field listed in this DID; if no data is available for field, leave null between pipe separators.

children.title: This contractor shall provide data to
children.content: This contractor shall provide data to the government that is extracted from the company's own maintenance system.  The files shall include the fields, formats, and any data specifications listed in the table below.  Each submission shall be an incremental file that includes data for all records that have been added to or updated in the company's maintenance system since the last file was submitted to the government.  The table below specifies required and optional fields and can be further tailored in the statement of work.
